en.dr-ali-peiravi: we read that they also help eliminate bladder stones.
God’s Prophet (MGB) used to eat melons with dates.
In another tradition it is reported that the Prophet (MGB) used to eat melons with sugar.
As-Sadiq (MGB) said, “Eating melons for breakfast would cause hemiplegia.
Eating Al-Barni dates for breakfast could also cause hemiplegia.”
